lead: Viv Richards is a widely followed Australian cricketer, born on 7 March 1952.
As of 2026, he is 74 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has represented West Indies cricket team and Glamorgan County Cricket Club and has been recognised with Officer of the Order of the British Empire and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
Below you will find a verified overview of Viv Richards: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
